role: 镜0开场引导白首帧＝男女主并坐靠近、朝镜头vlog式轻松带笑（留存钩子开场；I2VA单首帧）
prompt: Cinematic still, 9:16 vertical, medium shot, static, camera facing the sofa straight-on at eye level. A bright, airy neutral-warm living room, ceiling light on, soft diffuse daylight through sheer curtains, no dim moody lamp. A realistic East Asian Chinese couple in their early thirties sit close together side by side on a two-seat fabric sofa, shoulders almost touching, both turning to face the camera warmly and casually as if chatting into a phone camera in a home vlog. The woman (identity from the reference woman), shoulder-length loose dark brown hair, oatmeal-beige knit top, a relaxed light smile, looking into the lens. The man (identity from the reference man), short neat dark hair, plain light-grey crew-neck top, an easy natural grin, one arm resting relaxed. Warm, affectionate, comfortable everyday mood, the two clearly close and at ease. Matte skin with realistic pores, fine film grain, shot on an iPhone with true-to-life handheld realism, no oily facial glare, no highlight on faces, no plastic AI sheen, no wax. They are Chinese with East Asian faces, not western faces. Bright natural neutral-warm color, shallow depth of field. No text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark, no brand anywhere.
prompt_zh: 电影感静帧，9:16竖屏，中景，静态，镜头平视正对沙发。明亮通透中性偏暖客厅，顶灯开、纱帘漫射日光，无暗黄压抑灯。真实东亚中国情侣(30出头)并肩靠近同坐双人布艺沙发、肩几乎相贴，两人一起转向镜头、像对着手机拍vlog般轻松随意带笑。女主(参考女主身份)中长深棕披肩发、燕麦米色针织衫、放松浅笑看镜头；男主(参考男主身份)短发、素净浅灰圆领衫、自然咧嘴笑、一臂放松搭着。温暖亲昵、日常自在，两人明显亲密放松。哑光肤质有毛孔、自然颗粒，iPhone真实手持质感，无脸部油光/高光/塑料AI感/蜡感。中国东亚脸非欧美脸。明亮中性偏暖自然色，浅景深。无文字/字幕/logo/水印/品牌。
